source.job_name: iOS tests, release frameworks, and Swift wrapper
source.whole_run_failure_boundary: Saved jobs API records the Common, desktop, and Android release cleanup step as failure. That platform is reviewed separately; Apple success neither erases nor stitches a pass over D03.
source.binding: Saved run, attempt, jobs and artifact APIs; exact-SHA checkout and clean-Git logs; source-bound ownership; frozen Git blobs; hosted package inspector. Full-mode checkout fetch-depth 1 is intentional; this review used the full local frozen Git tree.
source.scope_limit: Evidence is at this exact frozen revision, not any later working-tree or committed Linux-only probe correction.

custody.checks: Original Apple ZIP lengths/digests match saved artifact APIs and collector command receipts. All 10,103 Apple members plus final cleanup member were read, CRC/SHA256/length-checked against the receipt; paths were checked for duplicate/unsafe/symlink entries. Historical/current classification was independently reconciled against frozen Git path membership. Extracted file sets and bytes exactly match the 277 selected Apple members and one cleanup member. All 25 Apple log members were independently rehashed against the retained log manifest; relevant raw logs were read directly without extraction.

apple_aggregate.runtime_evidence_scope: Only exact live parlor/parlor/<module>/build/test-results/iosSimulatorArm64Test XMLs. Each suite total matches actual testcase/failure/error/skipped nodes; all 465 descriptor names end [iosSimulatorArm64], are unique within module/suite, have fresh timestamps inside the successful aggregate cycle, and match all 13 unsuffixed runtime-task events. Fresh output ownership plus no cached/up-to-date aggregate tasks excludes historical reports or compilation-only substitutions.
apple_aggregate.linkage_and_count_limits: The three Release tasks are linkage only. ARM64-host iosX64Test is explicitly disabled by architecture mismatch and was not counted as passing runtime. Task SKIPPED/NO-SOURCE events are not testcase skips. Repeated Gradle log task headings around compiler warnings are not multiple executions.

normal_debug_xctest.configuration: Normal production Debug XCTest build and test, not an L08/OS39 copy-only fixture or libproc B lane
normal_debug_xctest.test_scope: Four UIKit tests compile the actual container source into the test target and check child semantics, bounds, decoration/orientation policies and appearance forwarding. One app-host XCTest launches com.parlor.app.debug, waits for runningForeground and parlor-home-brand, checks absence of an unexpected alert during its two-second observation window, and confirms foreground state. Only that one test is an actual production app cold-launch observation; the four container tests are not independent app launches.

xcresult.retention: Original Apple ZIP only; opaque native bundle not decoded using xcresulttool on Linux

normal_debug_xctest.stdout_custody: Every retained xcode-ui-test.log stdout line appears in the original timestamped Actions UI step log in order; raw five started/passed cases and suite totals reconcile.

unsigned_release_wrapper.target: Release iphonesimulator arm64, ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO
unsigned_release_wrapper.native_metadata_scope: Two arm64 IOSSIMULATOR Mach-O files in the hosted native file/lipo/vtool/dwarfdump report. Wrapper minimum OS16.0 and framework minimum OS15.0 are preserved, not normalized.
unsigned_release_wrapper.raw_resource_matches: All seven case JSONs and two fonts match frozen Git lengths/hashes and their package inventory records.
unsigned_release_wrapper.privacy: Source and shipped privacy hashes agree; hosted structural comparison passed.

notices.independent_check: All 26 source, package-notice and artifact-inventory records match frozen Git bytes/length/SHA256 at exact platform Compose paths. Source manifest and version-catalog raw hashes also match frozen blobs. No notice-byte normalization or legal-completeness inference.

unsigned_release_wrapper.stdout_custody: Every retained xcode-release-build.log stdout line appears in the original timestamped Actions wrapper step log in order.
unsigned_release_wrapper.retention_and_runtime_limit: Workflow does not upload the complete unsigned .app; it retains actual hosted package inspection, build logs and dSYM. This reviewer did not rehash a locally retained complete .app, run the Release wrapper, or verify Store signing. Xcode shallow -validate-for-store build output is not an App Store operation or Store-readiness proof.

cleanup.simulator_cleanup_scope: Exact nonce/run/attempt-bound UI simulator only; create UUID absent from the132-entry pre-create baseline, creation0, adoption journal and final delete0 agree. The frozen helper verifies Shutdown before deletion and absence in a subsequent authoritative inventory. Aggregate/wrapper simulator receipts are NOT_APPLICABLE, not a claim that every host CoreSimulator profile was removed.
cleanup.owned_exact_xcode_workers_retired: Wrapper cycle newly owned ibtoold lifetimes PID27303/start[1789039348,339054] and PID27298/start[1789039348,231683] received delivered SIGTERM. Both start after cycle claim and are absent from its native lifetime baseline. All before/after exact-worker scans PASS; aggregate/UI reported no owned survivors. No broad PID/name cleanup claimed.
cleanup.scope: Only attested live build/Python-cache roots. Root build deletion includes owned DerivedData. No tracked source, archived report build directories, or global caches were deletion targets. Hosted receipts are retained observations, not this Linux reviewer observing the retired runner. No local build or generated fixture was created by this review.
